name: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Image split into 16 jigsaw pieces that fly in rotated from outside the screen and snap together as the page scrolls. Visitors can drop their own image to replace it.
contents: Fixed SVG jigsaw of 16 image-filled pieces
Full-screen invisible file input with a dashed drop label
behavior: Piece positions and rotations are driven by scroll progress, assembling over the first viewport of scrolling
Dropping or choosing an image file replaces the puzzle picture
Dashed drop label fades in while a file is dragged over the page

props.name: labelText
props.default: Drop an image to update the jigsaw

editableByProps: Image, puzzle size, background and stroke color
Drop label text, size, color and corner radius

needsCodeEdit.change: Use a different piece shape or piece count
Change the starting rotation of pieces

fixed: Listens to window scroll and resize while mounted and removes the listeners on unmount
Scroll range comes from the pageHeight block (200vh) the root renders to give the pieces room to assemble
Puzzle and drop input are position fixed and cover the viewport
Piece paths are a fixed 4 by 4 layout
